reason: The template platform's port onto the agent-team store moved from lib/templates/runtime.ts and lib/templates/legacy-sources.ts into the squads module's squad-templates port (lib/squads/ports/squad-templates.ts, ADR-0250 §14), which breaks the templates/squads dependency cycle. It reads and writes the same store those files did; they stay members for the custom-mode and subagent stores they still read, so the move counts one new file. Repaid when the agent-team store is reached through the squads module's own state interface instead of the zustand store.
